name: Preset Pack Starter Edition
boundary: Public-safe preset summaries only. No private runtime internals, private coefficients, protected research details, partner details, or future-stack implementation details are included.

presets.name: Haunted Room
presets.summary: A room becomes more unsettling as suspicious or fearful activity repeats.

presets.name: Predator Trail
presets.summary: Repeated movement leaves a trail that can attract or guide a hunter-like response.

presets.name: Safe Path
presets.summary: Frequently successful routes become recognizable as safer paths.

presets.name: Danger Echo
presets.summary: Dangerous locations retain warning pressure after repeated threats.

presets.name: Loot Memory
presets.summary: Looted or valuable areas remember player attention and can change future incentives.

presets.name: Crowd Wear
presets.summary: Repeated crowd movement makes a space feel worn, busy, or socially stressed.

presets.name: Shrine Activation
presets.summary: Repeated interactions build toward a visible ritual or shrine response.

presets.name: Animal Territory
presets.summary: Creature presence and player intrusion shape territorial pressure.

presets.name: NPC Habit
presets.summary: Repeated NPC behavior makes locations feel habitual and expected.

presets.name: Encounter Scar
presets.summary: Intense encounters leave a persistent scar that can affect later tone or behavior.
